def: Taberah, a place in the Desert

occurrences.text: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.
And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth–hattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
